name: MomentumNarrative - Two Prose Columns
description: The narrative band in its new columns layout: two columns of prose, no figure at all, and the pull-quote spanning both beneath them. The layout the other three narrative frames cannot show — image-left, image-right and text-only all answer where the picture goes, and this one answers what if there is no picture. Tinted because that is how it renders on /donate as the page's first narrative, and because the pull quote is a WHITE card that would be invisible on an untinted band.
